name: race_offline_outcome_rival_fell
description: An offline race won by the rival's fall ends won, though my own hollow is neither done nor fallen (design 1.3's win order; review of M6: main.gd judged an offline race by my hollow's phase and called this lost). Racing the caretaker, the mirror's Holdfast goes under on a wave: the strip's second line says what I need ('Your rival fell on wave 8. Clear wave 8 to win') and nothing is decided yet; once my hollow has cleared that wave the simulation decides the race for me, SimMatch.outcomes() says won for my team, and the results say so: 'You Outran the Tide', 'Your rival fell on wave 8'.

steps.assert: fell >= 8 and Game.outcome() == '' and not Game.sim.over
steps.msg: the mirror fell; the race goes on until I clear that wave

steps.assert: node('Hud').rival_line() == 'Your rival fell on wave %d. Clear wave %d to win' % [fell, fell]
steps.msg: the strip says what I need to win
my hollow is in a build window: neither done nor fallen
the simulation decided the race for my team

steps.assert: node('ResultsPanel').results['outcome'] == 'won' and node('ResultsTitle').text == 'YOU OUTRAN THE TIDE' and node('ResultsRule').text == 'Your rival fell on wave %d' % fell
steps.msg: and the results say won, with the rule
